## PresenceSimulatorArmedOutcome type

The one-shot outcome a test can arm for a single upcoming call to a [PresenceSimulatorBackend](./test-helpers.presencesimulatorbackend.md) operation via [PresenceSimulatorBackend.armPresence()](./test-helpers.presencesimulatorbackend.armpresence.md)<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type PresenceSimulatorArmedOutcome = Exclude<PresenceSimulatorOutcome, 'not-capable'>;
```
**References:** [PresenceSimulatorOutcome](./test-helpers.presencesimulatoroutcome.md)

## Remarks

Excludes `'not-capable'`<!-- -->: arming an operation is itself the signal that the operation is presence-covered for that call. To model an operation the vault's own pre-check should refuse before the backend is touched, leave it unarmed and unscripted (the default) instead.
